releases.notes:
fix(ui): treat missing files as files when resolving open-folder

resolveDirectory used File.isFile(), which is false for a path that
does not exist yet (background.png before the user drops one). Use the
filename as a hint so Open Folder still targets the parent directory.
Also lock Performance.fastRender's source default to false.

Co-authored-by: Gao Yu <gaoyu06@users.noreply.github.com>
fix(ci): install shared Prism UI for releases

release: 1.0.2-beta

- ModsList: color modes (rainbow / chroma / brightness wave) with per-row
  offset, title size and color, solid and bar background styles, and a toggle
  enter/exit animation with fade/slide/zoom modes and adjustable speed
- ColorSetting: new WAVE_BRIGHTNESS type plus a per-setting speed multiplier
  and a speed slider in the color picker
- Multiplayer: bootstrap Forge server list data in the custom multiplayer
  screen, so modded server entries populate correctly
- Fixed a netty NPE crash in the server ping loop (#179)
- ClickGUI: module renderer no longer reaches into settings it should not

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(aot): notch-only AOT package without redistributed Minecraft jars

Ship runtime + mappings only, always launch against launcher-provided
notch client with runtime deobf, drop java3d:vecmath via in-tree matrices,
and expand mcmod.info from the Gradle version.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
